sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Traditional Meenakari Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Celebrate timeless Indian craftsmanship with this Traditional Meenakari Bracelet Watch, featuring delicate floral meenakari artwork, a premium gold-plated finish, and charming ghungroo accents. Designed to resemble a beautiful ethnic bracelet, this elegant wristwatch is the perfect accessory for festive occasions, weddings, and everyday traditional wear.
Its adjustable chain ensures a secure and comfortable fit, making it an ideal choice for women who love classic jewelry-inspired watches.
Features
-
Premium gold-plated finish
-
Handcrafted Meenakari floral design
-
Elegant ghungroo charm detailing
-
Lightweight & comfortable
-
Adjustable chain closure
-
Perfect for weddings, festivals & parties
-
Ideal gift for women & girls
Package Includes: 1 Traditional Meenakari Bracelet Watch
